Content:
The total displacement [MATH: d] of a particle over the time interval [MATH: t \in [a,b]] is the difference in the position of the particle between [MATH: t=a] and [MATH: t=b.]

Content:
[MATH: d = x(b) - x(a).]

Content:
Now, the fundamental theorem of calculus states that

Content:
[MATH: d = x(b) - x(a) = \int_a^b x'(t) \, \textrm dt]

Content:
and since [MATH: x'(t) = v(t),] we can find the total displacement of a particle by integrating the velocity:

Content:
[MATH: d = x(b) - x(a) = \int_a^b v(t) \, \textrm dt]

Content:
To summarize, the total displacement of a particle over the time interval [MATH: t \in [a,b]] can be found by integrating the velocity [MATH: v(t)] over the time interval [MATH: t\in[a,b].]

Content:
[MATH: d|= ∫_{a}^{b}v(t)dt]

Item 1 — Tutorial: Introduction

Content:
The total displacement [MATH: d] of a particle over the time interval [MATH: t \in [a,b]] is the difference in the position of the particle between [MATH: t=a] and [MATH: t=b.]

Content:
[MATH: d = x(b) - x(a).]

Content:
Now, the fundamental theorem of calculus states that

Content:
[MATH: d = x(b) - x(a) = \int_a^b x'(t) \, \textrm dt]

Content:
and since [MATH: x'(t) = v(t),] we can find the total displacement of a particle by integrating the velocity:

Content:
[MATH: d = x(b) - x(a) = \int_a^b v(t) \, \textrm dt]

Content:
To summarize, the total displacement of a particle over the time interval [MATH: t \in [a,b]] can be found by integrating the velocity [MATH: v(t)] over the time interval [MATH: t\in[a,b].]

Content:
[MATH: d|= ∫_{a}^{b}v(t)dt]

Item 2 — Example: Finding the Total Displacement of a Particle Given Its Velocity

Content:
EXPLANATION

Explanation:
We find the total displacement by calculating the definite integral of the velocity.

Let [MATH: d] be the total displacement. Then, we have
[MATH: d|= ∫_{1}^{3}(2t + 3t^{2})dt; = (t^{2} + t^{3})|_{1}^{3}; = [3^{2} + 3^{3}] − [1^{2} + 1^{3}]; = [9 + 27] − [1 + 1]; = 36 − 2; = 34.]

So the total displacement between [MATH: t=1] and [MATH: t=3] is [MATH: 34.]
